scope: Phase 1 of docs/MULTI-DEVICE.md: a model split by layers over several devices. Gate evidence for the phase 1 row: exact against one device on CPU+CPU and on two identical cards, HF bounds on CPU+Vulkan, the two Q8_0 models past one card on two MI50s, the Radeon VII with CPU stages, and no single-device regression.
limitations: The exact comparisons cover the scored text's prompt path and greedy decode of one sequence; a mixed server pass (a sequence decoding beside a fresh prompt) is checked separately.

No HF fixture exists for Qwen3-32B Q8_0 or Qwen3-30B-A3B Q8_0: HF in BF16 needs about 61 to 65 GB of host memory, more than either machine has free. Those two files are checked against llmx's CPU path, which the HF gate covers on the fixture models.
Binary hashes marked short were recorded to 16 hex digits by the run itself; the build tree was rebuilt afterwards.
Single-device performance rows are interleaved rounds on a shared machine, descriptive rather than an equivalence test.
